tei:div.tei:p: "$ (203)༄༅// rje btsun lho brag pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa snyan gyi shog dril bzhi'i lo rgyus gzhung lhan thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so/// /

(204)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mar pa lho brag pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa snyan gyi shog dril bzhi'i lo rgyus mi bla ma 'di la spyir rgya gar na bla ma mang du bzhugs kyang*/ khyad par du drin che ba nā ro mai tri gnyis yin skad/ de la dang po rgyud gdams pa mang du gsan zhing*/ dbang rdzogs par zhus nas bod du byon pa'i tshe/ gung thang gi mi la thos pa dga' zhes bya ba sgrub sems dang snying rus su 'dzoms pa gcig gis gdams ngag zhur 'ong ste/ lus ngag gi zhabs tog gis mnyes par byas pa la/ bla mas kyang gsang sngags bla na med pa'i rdzogs rim gyi snying po gtum mo a thung gi gdams pa gnang nas/ 'bad rtsol drag pos bsgoms kyang drod rtags yon tan 'char du ma btub nas/ slar yang bla ma la spyi bo rtol bskyed nas zhus te/ khyed kyis rgya gar lta bur byon zhing*/ nā ro mai tri la sogs pa'i bla ma bzang po mang du bsten pa la/ yun ring por bsgom bsgrub bya mi dgos pa'am/ de bas kyang ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo zhig yod par nges pas thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ sgom yun ring du byas pa'am/ yun ring du 'bad rtsol drag pos nyams len byas (205)pas sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa te snga gong nas 'gyur yod byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs kyis dgongs nas kyang kho bden par 'dug snyams nas/ slar yang rgya gar du bla ma rnams la bka' drin dang rjes su mthun pa'i bsnyen bkur du byon nas/ snga ma ltar zhu ba mdzad de/ bod du 'ong ba'i dus su/ rje nā ro pas rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo dang 'pho ba spyi brdol gnyis gnang ste/ sngags thabs lam gyi mthar thug 'di gnyis yin pas/ 'di lta bu'i gdams pa rgya gar na yang dkon par yod pas khyod rang la yang rgyus yod mod/ khyed kyis bod blo chung la the tshom che bas/ kun la bstan du mi rung*/ gang zag gi snod legs par brtags nas sbyin dgos pa yin gsung*/

mnga' bdag mai tri pas bar do blo chod dang*/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus kyi gdams pa gnyis gnang nas/ 'di gnyis kun la bstan pa bya ba'i chos min pas/ gang zag skal ldan gcig la bka' rgya dang bcas te chos gtod cig gsung*/ bla ma mar bas kyang sngar gyi gdams pa rnams las khyad par 'phags shing bla mas kyang thugs la mchog tu btags par gzhig /gdams pa'i yi ge rnams shog dril du byas nas mgul du btags te/ kun la (206)ma bstan to// dus phyis dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge zhes pas zhabs tog cher byas nas zhu ba drag tu phul te/ bdag nges par 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes pa zhig yin pas gdams pa tshegs chung la don che ba zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zer bas/ mar pa'i thugs dgongs la/ ga re 'di lta bu'i gdams pa zab mo kun la sbyin na bla ma'i bka' rgya yod/ bu dar ma mdo sde la gcig brgyud du gtad rgyu yin te khong ni grongs nas mi bzhugs/ mi la ras pa yang zhur ma byung*/ da yang gdams pa zab mo dur du khyer ba la dgos pa ci yang med/ jo bo mtshur ston 'di dad gus kyang che/ sngags kyi chos la blo yang khel/ nyams su len nges shig 'dug /'di lta bu la gdams pa ma byin na chos la ser sna byas pa dang*/ dad pa can sun phyung ba'i nyes pa 'ong snyams nas shog dril bzhi po 'di gtad de/ khyed kyang gang zag skal ldan tu 'dug pas/ ngas gdams pa 'di snying phyung nas byin pa yin gyis/ gces par zung la su dga' dga' la ma ster/ gang zag snod ldan byung na bka' rgyas thob la byin gsung ngo*// mtshur dbang nges 'pho ba spyi brtol ces pa sku mched la gnang*/ de 'dza' phu rgya gar la/ des stod lung 'ga' ras/ des slob dpon nyi ma lung ba/ des bde gshegs rin po che ste/ steng sgo la rtags thon pa sha stag byon/ brgyud pa mi gsang bar gda'o// gzhan shog dril gsum po ma gnang bar yod pa la/ bla ma la ras chung pa'i slob ma gcig gis mtshur ston dbang nge la shog dril bzhi'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can yod bya ba thos nas/

seng ge sna bya ba'i g.yu rdog rta sum brgya ri ba gcig phul te zhu ba drag tu phul bas thugs la btags te/ shog dril bzhi po legs par gnang nas ngas shi bar du gzhan la gsang zhig bya ba'i bka' rgya gtad do// zhu ba po de snyag sgom dgos chung ba yin par gda'/ khong dang dwags po mdo rtse gsung gleng byung ba na/ mtshur dbang (207)de'i shog dril bzhi bya ba de nga la yod zer/ 'o na nga dang khyed sngon chad mched grogs yin te phyin chad rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pas cis kyang zhu byas nas zhus te nan tan byas pas/ snyag sgom gyi zhal nas/ nga dang khyed mched grogs snying dang 'dra ba yin pas sbyin gyis/ 'di la zhus bya ba ma zer/ gar dgar yang ma sbyin brgyud pa yang ma bcad gsung ngo*// dwags po mdo rtse'i spyan sngar slob dpon nyi ma lung pas bka' bzhi'i gdams pa zhur phyin pa'i tshe/ khong gi zhal nas/ bla ma mar pa de la gdams pa khyad par can mang po yod par gda' ste/ jo sras mdo sde la sbyin par dgongs nas kun la ma gnang ba 'dra/ sras grongs ma thag tu khong rang yang sku gshegs nas gdams pa rim gcig bka' chad pa'i rigs su 'dug /dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge la shog dril bzhi bya ba gzhan la ma gnang ba zhig gnang yod par gda'/ gzhung gi mes ston tshon chung ba la bsre ba gsum gyi gdams ngag bya ba gnang yod par gda' gsung*/ de kun la chos ci 'dra yod dam zhus pas/ shog dril bzhi po de la 'pho ba spyi brtol/ rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo// bar do blos chod/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus bya ba yod par gda' gsung*/ bsre ba skor gsum bya ba de/ chang dang bsam gtan bsre ba/ gnyid dang bsam gtan bsre ba/ thig le dang bsam gtan bsre ba bya ba yod par gda' gsung*/ rje btsun gyis mkhyen te 'ongs pas zhu dgos byas pas/ ngas mi shes gsungs nas zhal 'dzum 'dzum mdzad cing 'dug gsung skad/ der mkhyen par shes nas zhu ba drag tu phul bas/

shog dril bzhi po legs par gnang ste su la zhus dris pas brgyud pa gsang bar gda' gsungs nas zlo ru ma btub// phyis rtsad bcad pas snyag sgom la zhus par gda' gsung*/ slob dpon dwags po'i zhal nas nga'i gdams pa nyi 'og gi rgyal khams na zab pa 'di lta bu zhu ba la/ yon tu brgya 'bul yan chad re med pas mi 'thob gsung (208)pa la/ de dus zang zing gi dngos po 'bul rgyu med pas gdung khang mtho bcu ma gcig phul nas zhus gsungs so// slob dpon nyi ma lung pas/ stod lung 'ga' ras la 'pho ba spyi brtol gyi gdams pa zhur byon pa la/ yon tu gser srang re/ tshogs kyi yo byad la sha khog re re/ shes rab kyi rdzas dang bcas pa dgos shing gda' ba la/ cha rkyen ni med/ chos la gdung ba drag po ni yod pas/ phrug phyam bzang po gcig gis sna drangs pa'i khong rang gi na bza' lus gang ci yod phul nas zhus pas gnang ste/ rjes la khyed dge slong chos gos dang bral ba de mi rung gsungs nas sham thabs sku rags rnams gtad do// de la bde gshegs rin chen gyis zhus te khong sga 'dra'i chab tshan khar bzhud pa'i lam du bsnyen bkur mdzad pa'i tshe shog dril bzhi'i gsung gleng byung nas mos pa drag po skyes te/ de ma thag tu tshogs 'khor bshams/ na bza' phrug phyam bzang po gser srang gang ri ba zhig yod pa sku nas phud de phul bas dgyes bzhin du gnang ste/ 'pho ba spyi brtol ma bka' rgyas ma btab/ gzhan gsum po nga ma shi'i bar du yod skad kyang ma zer/ de nas khyed rang gi thugs dgongs dang sbyor mdzod gsungs so// de la bdag gis zhus te/ zhu ba'i mched grogs dge slong sgrub pa po bya ba 'di dag gis chos 'di'i snyan pa thos nas khong rang gi gos phya ru bzang po gcig gis sna drangs pa'i zhu rten lan gsum du phul nas/ lan gsum du zhu ba drag po byas pas phyi ma la gnang*/ bdag kyang de dang dus 'dzom ste/

zhal gdams dang bcas pa bdag gcig pu la gnang ste gzhung chung gnyis gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i lo rgyus so// da nas rus phyis 'di snyam du 'pho ba spyi brtol dang*/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus gnyis la/ nā ro mai tri nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba rgya gar ma re re 'dug pas/ gzhan gnyis la mi 'ong ba ji ltar yin snyam nas yod tsam nas/ rtsa rlung drwa (209)mig gi 'khor lo dang*/ bar do blos chod gnyis kyi rtsa ba rgya gar ma gnyis po bla ma sum pa ras pa'i phyag nas byon te shog dril ma bu legs par 'grigs par gyur to// khong la yang sngar zhal gdams mi bzhugs par 'dug /rtsa ba'i shog dril phyi mo rje btsun mar pa'i sku dreg can mtshur gyis snyag sgom la gnang ma thag zhal gdams rnams thugs la legs par lon te/ rtsa ba cung zad ma lon pa la/ grub thob dbus ras bya ba ldom bu la byung nas mgur len cing 'dug pas gsan nas snang ba 'gyur te/ de ma thag tu shog dril mgul nas bcad nas phul/ phyis dwags po mdo rtse la thugs nas gnang ba yin par gda'/ dbus ras kyi shog dril phyi mo gzhan su la ma bstan par sras la gcig brgyud du gnang*/ de la bla ma sum ras kyis zla ba drug gi bar du bsnyun g.yog dang sman bcos byas te/ sku srog bton pas drin lan tu shog dril gyi gdams pa gnang ste/ khyed kyis phyag dpe snying pa'i steng nas gcig bshus la nga la zhog la khyed rang gdan drangs gsungs nas de ltar mdzad de/ phyi mo kho rang la phul lo// rje btsun mar pa'i sku dreg yod pa'i phyag dpe nga rang la gnang ba de 'bum gcig phul ba las dga' gsungs nas bzhad skad do// rgya gar skad du/ tṛ ṇa pra ṇa dzā la tsakra/ bod skad du/ rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo// rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bde drod lus 'bar lus kyi dwangs ma zhu// dhū ti'i lam sbyangs 'od gsal nam mkha' blta// 'khor

'di la gsum/ klad/ gzhung*/ mjug go /dang po mtshan phyag gnyis so// gnyis la sbyor dngos gnyis so// dngos gzhi steng 'og gnyis so/ /bar 'khrul bcad thig le'i chu lud kyis// byang chub myu gu rdo rje can la 'dud// dbang dang dam gang zag tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor bas// bden pa'i spyod lam gnas su bde ba'i snyan la 'dug /mgon pos dang po la sgom pa ni/ mgor brgyan yi (210)dam bsgom pa yi// lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhir gnas pa'i// dhū ti lus kyi srog shing tshul du gnas// yar sna spyi bo'i haṃ la rnam par bltas// mar sna'i a las g.yos pa'i rlung sdig pas// a las me 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ zhu las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs gtum mo'i gsos su gyur// de gnyis pa skyon bsal ba ni/ ltar bsgoms pa'i thun rjes thun rjes la// rke 'then mgo dang ro stod rked pa dang*// bskor zhing gcus la yan lag sprug par bya// man ngag yin pas dbugs thebs bdun par bya// de dgos pa/ yis rtsa rlung thig le'i skyon rnams sel/ /de ltar bsgoms pas dang po drod skye ste// rtsa kha dros nas khams kyi dwangs ma zhu// nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa'i bde ba 'byung*// gsum 'og sgo la sbyor ba dngos gnyis las/dang po ni dngos gzhi drug las/ pa'i dbang bskur mtshan ldan phyag rgya gtad// phyag rgya de dang ldan pa lnga ldan gyis/ dang po dbabs la mkhas pa/ /dal bus bsrub cing don gyi nam mkha' blta// mkhas pa lnga yi sgo nas nyams su blang*// de yi myong ba lhan skyes ye shes yin/ gnyis pa 'dzin pa la mkhas pa/ /'og rlung gyen tu gzugs dbang gyen la blta// rkang pa gsum pa drang ba la mkhas pa/ mthar rkyang rkan so bcon tu bzung// rgya mtsho rir sbyar dri 'dzin gyen tu bzlog /rig pa mkhar gtad gnas lugs don la blta// de ltar gnad ldan hūm̐ ring hūm̐ thung gis// 'khor lo bzhi yi gnas su drang ba yin// dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes skye bar 'gyur// gcan gzan

bzhi pa bkram pa la mkhas pa/ hūm̐ gi snom dang wa yi bzhad// stag mo'i skyug stangs stag dang seng ge'i sprug /sbyor ba de yi lus la khyab par khrem// mgo bo lnga pa skyon sel ba mkhas pa/ lan gsum dril zhing ro stod gcu// sked pa lan gsum gcu zhing ro smad brdab// rkang lag lan gsum sprug pas thig le yi// nad mi 'jug pa'i man ngag sems la zhog /de rjes drag pa dung yang gnas lugs so/ sems nyid ma bcos rang sar zhog /(211)nyin mo steng sgo sbyang zhing mtshan mo 'og sgo sbyong*// steng 'og 'jug la mtshan phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ rtsa rlung drwa mig 'brel pa las// skyon sel thabs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'o// 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas// zhag bdun sbyor bas mkha' spyod nges par 'grub// rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ / rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo 'di la gnyis te/ bde drod kyi me sbar nas khams kyi dwangs ma bzhu ste dhū ti'i lam sbyangs nas 'od gsal gyi nam mkha' blta ba dang*/ 'og 'khor ba'i rgyu 'grul bcad de thig le'i chu lud kyis rtsa rlung gi ljon shing bskyed nas rdo rje 'chang gi sa la 'god par bstan pa'o// steng sgo la gnyis te/ gnad rnam pa lngas gdams pa nyams su blangs ba dang*/ 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lngas rlung gi skyon sel ba'o// dang po gnad rnam pa lnga ni/ rten pa lus kyi gnad/ gnas pa rtsa'i gnad/ g.yo ba rlung gi gnad/ 'dzin pa sems kyi gnad/ grol ba chos nyid kyi gnad do// dang po rten pa lus kyi gnad ni/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug la skyil krung tsog pu bya/ sha ching tshad ldan bcing*/ mnyam bzhag lta ba'i 'og tu bcing*/ rang lus yi dam lhar bskyed/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom la gsol ba gdab bo// gnas pa rtsa'i gnad ni/ lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal gdab ste/ spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis so// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug

/snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad// lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la/ rtsa gsum srog shing gi tshul du gnas te/ lus kyi dbus rtsa a wa dhū ti'i yar sna spyi bo'i haṃ la zug /mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi na chos 'byung gru gsum pa la zug pa'o// ro ma dang rkyang ma sna bug nas gyen la log ste klad pa'i steng nas mar 'khyog nas 'khor lo bzhi la 'khyud de/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas kha gtugs pa/ sbom phra (212)mda' smyug tsam lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma ltar snyol le snying nge gnas so// g.yo ba rlung gi gnad ni/ dang po srog rtsol gyi rlung mnyam du rgyu'am mi rgyu brtag /ma rgyu na thabs kyis snyams nas/ dang po rlung grang mo lan gsum phyir bus pas rlung nang mi 'jug /de nas rlung drag po lan gsum gyis dgang ste/ rtsa gsum rlung gis dgang nas lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar thig les gang bar bsam/ de nas rngub steng rlung thub tshad mnan/ 'og rlung drag tu bsdam/ steng rlung mi thub tsa na sna bug nas zhad re btang zhing lhag ma bsdam mo// de la pho rlung du 'jug na drag po shugs dang ldan par bsdam/ mo rlung du 'jug na 'jam por grogs kyis mi tshor tsam du mnan no// 'dzin pa sems kyi gnad ni/ de ltar rlung 'jug pa'i tshe lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdo na rtsa gtum mo a shad kyi rnam pa mgal dum me la bsregs pa lta bu zhig bsam/ de la rtsa g.yas g.yon gyi rlung gi nus pas 'gal dum la phus btab pas me 'bar ba bzhin du rtsa gtum mo la me 'bar te dhū ti'i nang na yar la dmar rgyang rgyang song ste/ me de yang tsha ba/ gdung ba/ rno ba/ 'brel par 'bar bar bsam mo// de la 'khor lo bzhi'i thig le rnams rim pas bsros te/ me lce de je ring je ring la spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lo thig le byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin haṃ dkar po mgo mthur la bstan pa lta bu gcig yod pa de la me lce reg reg song bas/

haṃ las thig le 'bab ste me gseb tu sar sar song bas bde ba chen po lhang lhang skyes par bsam/ de yang dang po nas ma yin te/ lus la gtum mo'i drod skyes pa dang*/ bde ba rim gyis 'bebs pa yin no// de yang lus drod shas che zhing bde ba shas chung na thig le 'beb pa'i dmigs pa gtso bor gtad/ bde ba shas che nas lus rab tu g.yos na me 'bar ba la dmigs pa gtad/ spyir na res 'jog tu byed pa yin no// grol ba chos nyid kyi gnad ni/ de ltar thun bzhi'am ci nus su nyams (213)su blangs nas thun mtshams su bya ba gzhan dang ma bsre bar shes pa kho na la ma bcos par bzhag /gal te rtog pa 'phro na sems la gzhig 'grel btang*/ cir yang ma grub pa'i shes pa'i ngang la ma bcos par glod la bzhag go /de ni gnad rnam pa lngas nyams su blang ba yin te/ de ltar bsgoms pas lus la drod skye/ drod las bde ba skye/ bde ba las mi rtog pa skye/ de las phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor rnam pa lngas rlung gi skyon bsal ba ni/ thun zhabs nyal ba'i dus su steng 'og gi rlung bzung bas rked pa yan nyir gcig bskor/ mgo lan bdun sprug /ro stod lan bdun cu/ lag pa shag len bdun bya/ sked pa bya mnyed lan bdun bya/ des lus la nad gang yang mi 'byung ba yin no// de nas phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la nyid nyal nas bsdad do// gnad kyi man ngag dam pa kun la med pa'i khyad chos yin no// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ 'og sgo la gnyis te/ mkhas pa lngas nyams su blang ba dang*/ sprug thabs rnam pa lngas thig le'i skyon bsal ba'o// mkhas pa lnga ni/ dang po thig le 'bebs pa la mkhas pa mgar ba mkhas pas me long rdung ba lta bu dang*/ 'dzin pa la mkhas pa rdzing khung gi 'or bsdum pa lta bu dang*/ 'dren pa la mkhas pa khron chu dbyangs thag la 'dren pa lta bu dang*/ 'grem pa la mkhas pa 'bras zhing la chu lud btad do// lta bu dang*/

ye shes chen por 'gro ba la mkhas pa nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bu'o// dang po thig le 'bebs pa la mkhas pa mgar ba mkhas pas me long brdung ba lta bu ni/ me long brdung ba'i tshe tsha drag na yang 'go /grang drag na yang 'chag pas smug ting ba bzhin tu/ thig le yang bsrubs drag na 'chor/ ma bsrubs na na yang bde ba mi skye bas dal bus bsrub pa yin no// de yang lag len la sbyor ba dbang dang gdams ngag legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa btsal ste/ (214)las rgyu 'bras kyi chos kyis dad pa bskyed/ dbang gis rgyud smin par bya/ zab mo'i chos kyis nges shes bskyed do// de nas dben pa'i gnas su mthun pa'i cha rkyen gsog la/ yab yum gnyis stan gcig la 'dug la/ yab yum gnyis ka lhar bskyed/ mkha' gsang rdo rje pad+mar byin gyis brlab/ khams thams cad dpa' bo dang dpa' mor byin gyis brlabs la/ dal gyis snyoms 'jug bya'o// de yang bde ba mgo skyes tsam na 'phro bcad la sems gnas lugs kyi ngang la lhod kyis bzhag /yang bde ba ro yal tsam na bsrub po// de ltar yang nas yang du byas pas mjug tu bde ba rgyas pas/ rtsa rlung thams cad me bzhin tu 'bar/ thig le thams cad chu bzhin tu 'brub nas/ thig le 'chor snyoms byed pa'i rtog pa 'ong ngo*// de la gnyis/ thig le 'dzin pa la mkhas pa rdzing gi 'or khung bsdoms pa lta bu ni/ rdzing gi 'or khung ma bsdoms na chu mi chags pa bzhin tu/ thig le 'dzin ma shes na rten gyi nus pa nyams nas thabs kyi yon tan mi 'char ro// de la gnad bzhi ste/ gzugs dbang steng du lta ba/ dbyangs thag gyen tu drang ba/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar ba/ rig pa mtha' la brgyang ba'o// gzugs dbang gyen la lta ba ni/ mig gyen la lta ba'o// dbyangs thag gyen la drang ba ni/ steng rlung yan bar bzhag la 'og rlung drag po lan gsum du thub tshad yar la 'then pa'o// rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar ba ni/

rgyu ma rgal pa la gcar gyis sbyar ba'o// rig pa mtha' la brgyang ba ni/ sems nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa la brgyang ba'o// de ltar drag po lan gsum gyis zin nges so// de nas sems gnas lugs kyi ngang la bzhag go /de nas yang sngar bzhin tu sbyang ngo*// de nas 'dren pa la mkhas pa khron chu gyen la 'dren pa lta bu ni/ gnad bzhi ste/ rlung gi lcags kyus bzung ba/ hūm̐ gi thag pa 'dogs pa/ chu bo gyen la bzlog pa/ (215)steng gi yur ba bsal ba'o// rlung gi lcags kyus bzung ba ni/ 'og rlung drag tu gyen la 'then pa'o// hūm̐ gi thag pa 'dogs pa ni/ rlung gyen la 'then pa'i tshe/ hūm̐ gi sgra dang bcas pa'o// chu bo gyen la bzlog pa ni/ rgyu zhabs rgal pa la gcar nas gyen la brdzangs pa'i tshul gyis 'phul ba'o// steng gi yur ba bsal ba ni/ gnad gsum gcig tu dril nas thig le gsang gnas na dkar spung nge yod pa de rlung drag po lan gsum 'then pas/ smyug sbubs kyis chu 'thung ba'i tshul gyis lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor drang ngo*// yang lan gsum gyis snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor drang*/ yang lan gsum gyis mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor drang*/ yang lan gsum gyis spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lor drang*/ de na thig le skya spung nge 'dug par bsam mo// de nas 'grem pa la mkhas pa 'bras zhing la chu btang ba lta bu ni/ gcan gzan gyi 'gyur ba lngas bkram ste/ rgyu bzhi

rdo rje la ching yang zer/ la brten la bcing*/ steng 'og gi rlung drag tu gcud la/ ri dwags kyi 'dug stangs/ gcan gzan gyi snom tshul/ wa mo'i bzhad tshul/ seng ge sprug stangs/ stag mo'i skyug stangs kyis snam bu chur gcir ba bzhin tu lus thams cad thig les khyab par bkram mo/ bar der sprug stangs lngas skyon bsal bar bya ste/ mgo lan gsum bsgril/ ro stod lan gsum gcu/ smad lan gsum brdab/ lag pa lan gsum sprug /rkang pa lan gsum sprug go /des thig le'i gegs 'jug mi srid do// tha ma ye shes chen por 'gro ba nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa lta bu ni/ de'i rjes la sems ma bcos par rang sar glod la bzhag pas/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po rgyud la 'char ba yin no// de ltar nyin mo ni steng gnad rnam pa lnga la brten nas sbyong ba dang*/ mtshan mo thig le las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas sbyong ba ni/ steng 'og rlung drwa mig ltar 'brel ba zhes bya'o// yang skor thabs gsum gyis steng rlung gi skyon bsal ba dang*/ sprug (216)thabs gsum gyis thig le'i gegs sel ba ni 'khor lo bskor ba zhes bya'o// des na rtsa rlung drwa mig 'khor lo zhes bya'o// 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas nges pa yin no// gnad kyi gdams pa khyad par can// kun la bstan pa'i gnas med do// bla ma mar pa lo tsā'i shog dril bzhi'i gdams pa las/ 'di rtsa rlung drwa mig gi zhal gdams yin te/ snga ma phan chad gcig brgyud las med do// rab tu gsang ba'o/ u pa de sha'o// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ma hā mu dra sañca ya gā tha/ bod skad du/ phyag rgya chen po tshig bsdus pa// bde chen ngang la phyag 'tshal nas// phyag rgya chen po brjod par bya// chos rnams thams cad rang snang ba sems su bstan gi sems// phyi rol don mthong 'khrul pa'i blo// rmi lam bzhin te ngo bo stong*// sems kyi dran

sems stong par bstan/ rig 'gyu ba tsam// rang bzhin med de rlung gi rtsal// ngo bo stong pa nam mkha' bzhin// chos sku mkha' 'dra mnyam gnas la// phyag rgya che zhes brjod pa yin// rang gi ngo bo bstan tu med// de phyir sems kyi rang bzhin nyid// phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin can// phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nyid la// de las bcos shing bsgyur du med// gang gis de nyid mthong rtogs na// snang srid thams cad phyag rgya che// chos sku phyag rgya chen po la// rang bzhin ma bcos rnal mar bzhag /bsam du med pa chos kyi sku// ma btsal bzhag na sgom pa ste// btsal zhing sgom na 'khrul pa'i blo// mkha' dang cho 'phrul ji lta bar// bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis med par// bral dang ma bral ga la yod// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dge dang sdig pa'i las rnams kun// de nyid shes pas grol bar 'gyur// nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste// nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor grogs// 'gro dang 'dug pa ga la yod// dgon par phyin nas bsam gtan ci// de nyid ma (217)rtogs gang gis grol// gnas skabs tsam las grol mi nus// de nyid rtogs na gang gis 'ching*// ngang las ma yengs gnas pa las// lus ngag bcos shing bsgom du med// mnyam par bzhag dang ma bzhag ces// 'di la gang yang ma grub ste// snang ba rang grol chos kyi dbyings// rtogs pa rang grol ye shes che// gnyis med mnyam pa chos kyi sku// chu bo chen po'i rgyun ltar 'bab// gang ltar gnas kyang don dang ldan// 'di ni rtag tu sangs rgyas nyid// 'khor ba yul med bde ba che// chos rnams rang rang ngo bos stong*// stong par 'dzin blo rang sar dag /blo bral yid la byar med pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyi lam// skal pa rab tu gyur pa la// bdag gis snying gtam tshig tu bsdus// 'di yis 'gro ba ma lus pa// phyag rgya che la gnas par shog

/zhal gyi gdams pa tshig bsdus so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yid la mi byed pa phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes da lta nyid du ngo sprad par 'dod pas/ skye bo'i 'du 'dzi las dben pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la dang po nyid du mos pa'i 'dug stangs zhes bya ste/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar te 'dug la/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma dam pa spyan drangs te/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas gsol ba dung dung ba zhig gdab/ de'i byin rlabs kyis rgyu dang cung zad dros pa na/ lus mnyam gzhag tu bya zhing yi dam gyi lhar bskyed/ mig sna rtse'i thad ka'i nam mkhar mig 'bras ma 'gul par rtse gcig tu dril la ji ltar tsam tshugs tshugs su blta bar bya ste/ bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ mig ni mi btsum sems ni 'gags pa dang*// rlung 'gags pa ni dpal ldan bla mas rtogs// zhes gsung zhing*/ de nyid kyis ngag rlung gi 'gyu ba yang bag gis chad par 'gyur mod kyi/ rtsol bas kyang cung zad bzung bar bya ste/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ me dang rlung (218)dang dbang chen 'gags pa na// bdud rtsir rgyu ba'i dus su rlung ni sems la 'jug /gsungs la/ de nyid kyis rnam par rtog pa'i 'gyu ba sna tshogs shugs la 'gag par 'gyur mod kyi/ bzang ngan mtho dman re dogs kyi rtog pa gang yang yid la mi bya bar gal bo che zin pa'am/ thang chad pa ngal sos pa'am/ yid mthun gyi grogs dang 'phrad pa lta bur bde 'bol le/ shig ge /lhan ne bzhag par bya ste/ de nyid kyis/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// klod na grol bar the tshom med// gsungs so// gal te gang ltar byas kyang sems gnas su mi btub par chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du/ rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs su thol thol skye bar gyur na/ dang po rtog pa'i byung sa rtsad bcad pas/ 'di nas byung bya ba'i byung sa mi rnyed/

tha mar 'gro sa rtsad bcad pas/ 'dir 'gro ba'i 'gro sa ma rnyed/ bar du rang gi ngo bo dbyibs dang kha dog gi dngos por ma grub ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong par shes pas/ dran rtog ci skyes/ yang dag par rnam par mi rtog pa chos kyi dbyings su grol bas phan gnod ma nus pa ni/ lbu ba chur zhi'am/ lho sprin nam mkhar thim pa lta bu ste/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ sems nyid me long nang du gzugs brnyan 'char ba de// rkyen shar yin te bden par ma 'dzin kye// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ dran pa'i kha rlangs sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin// 'di la bdag po 'dug pa ngas ma mthong*// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bla mas ngo sprod cing 'phrod pa'i don la ma yengs par bskyang bar bya'o// mdor na phyag rgya chen po yang dag pa'i nyams len ni/ stong pa phyogs gcig blo yul su byed pa ma yin te/ gzhi snang stong dbyer med kyi steng du/ lam rig stong 'dzin med/ 'bras bu ched du byed pa blo'i dri ma gang yang med pa/ blo bral du lhan ne 'jog pa zhig yin te/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i don// (219)'bras bu gang du'ang re bar ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs so// phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngo sprod// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ urda sh+ts+yo ta u pa de sha// bod skad du/ gong du 'pho ba'i man ngag /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bstan pa'i chos gzhan rnyed sla ste// 'di yi sbyor ba rnyed pa dka'// sbyor ba rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor pas// don gnyer 'bras bu dka' ma yin// nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang*// mtshams med lnga ni spyod pa dang*// mi dge bcu la spyod pas kyang*// lam 'dir zhugs na 'grub par 'gyur// ji ltar me tog pad+ma ni// 'dam gyi nang nas mdzes pa ltar// de bzhin 'dam 'dra'i lus dag las// ye shes rang dgar skye bar 'gyur// lha yi rnal 'byor ldan pa'i lus// rtsa yi gnas lugs gong ltar yin// a yi rnam pa hūm̐ du bsgoms// g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi mas snar yang*// hūm̐ chung re re bsgom par bya// skyil krung mnyam bzhag sgal tshigs bsrangs// gsus pa sgal pa'i tshigs la sbyar// steng rlung mnan la 'og rlung 'then// hika gi sbyor bas hūm̐ gsum po// gcig tu dril la gyen tu 'phang*// sbyang dgang bteg dang dbab pa dang*// sbyor ba'i yi ge phyed dang gnyis// nyin mtshan gang dang gcig gis 'grub// 'jog pa'i dus su phab la bzhag

/'chi ltas byung na rnal 'byor pas// mar la mi dbab yar la 'pho// 'gro ba rnams ni rab dbang med// de yi lam gyis 'gag par 'gyur// nyi shu rtsa gcig dbugs dag gis// 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste// me tog char 'bebs mkha' 'gros bskor// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsu// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// de phyir gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad dka' bas// 'gro ba thams cad 'di yi snod gyur nas// kun kyang rdo rje (220)'dzin pa thob par shog /'pho ba spyi brdol ma*/ ༈ na mo gu ru/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can 'khor ba nas sgrol bar byed pa'i thabs la chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs na yang*/ mdor bsdus na theg pa che chung gnyis las/ 'dir theg pa chen po'o// de la rgyu mtshan nyid kyis theg pa dang*// 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ 'di ni gsang sngags kyi theg pa chen po'o// de la bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi las// 'di ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do// 'di ni thabs lam dang grol lam gnyis las thabs lam mo// thabs lam la bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las bskyed rim myur ldan tsam zhig ston kyang gtso bo rdzogs rim yin no// rdzogs rim la yang lam gyi gtso bo dang yan lag gnyis las/ lam gyi yan lag go /lam gyi gtso bo la gnyis te/ steng sgo rnam sar grol ba'i lam gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ 'og sgo bde ba chen po'i lam las rgya'i rnal 'byor ro// lam gyi yan lag ni/ 'pho ba dang*/ grong 'jug dang*/ sgyu lus dang*/ 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ bar do'i gdams pa dang drug las/ 'di ni lam gyi yan lag gi nang nas kyang 'pho ba/ 'pho ba la lugs mang yang*/ 'di 'pho ba spyi brdol bya ba/

gnad gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa rtags mngon sum du 'byung ba'i lam yin no// 'di la gnad rnam pa bzhi ste/ brten pa lus kyi gnad/ gnas pa rtsa'i gnad/ g.yo ba rlung gi gnad/ 'dzin pa sems kyi gnad do// de la 'di nyams su len pa'i dus dben pa'i gnas su mthun pa'i cha rkyen bsags te bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom ste gsol ba drag tu gdab bo// (221)de nas brten pa lus kyi gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung du bca'/ lag pa mnyam bzhag phyag rgya lte ba'i 'og tu bcing*/ sgal tshigs drang por thal gyis bsrang*/ rang yi dam gyi lha gang mos su bsgom/ lha de yang nang khrol yod pa ma yin te/ khog pa stong par bsgom mo// gnas pa rtsa'i gnad ni/ rtsa dbu ma'i yar sna tshangs bug la thug pa/ mthong khung kha bye ba ltar dkar sang nge 'dug pa'i khar yig 'bru khruṃ nag po gcig gis bcad pa/ de bla ma spyi bo na bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong gis mnan par bsgom mo// rtsa mar sna ni lte ba'i 'og song bzhin rtsa mdud gru gsum pa la thug par bsgom/ rtsa gnyis po'i yar sna ni sna bug la zug nas klad pa'i steng nas tshur la 'khyogs te 'jing pa nas byang khog nas mar la song nas lte ba'i 'og rtsa mdud gru gsum pa'i steng na rtsa dbu ma la kha gtugs nas 'dug par bsam/ g.yo ba rlung gi gnad la bzhi/ 'phang ba dang*/ dgang ba dang*/ bteg pa dang*/ dbab pa'o// dang po ni/ rlung drag po lan gsum sna nas phyir la 'bud/ des rlung grang mo nang du ma tshud pas rlung nad mi 'byung ba yin no// dgang ba ni rtsa gsum po de khang stong gi ka ba bzhin tu khog pa'i nang na mar la lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma phus ma btab pa bzhin snyol le snyid de 'dug par bsam/ de nas steng rlung drag po lan gsum mnan pas/ sna bug gnyis nas rlung byung bas lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis na mar ltang ltang song nas lte ba'i 'og nas rlung dhū ti'i nang du zhugs nas rtsa gsum ka lug rdzud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar ltang ltang song bar bsam mo// de yang kha dog dmar po sbom phra mda' smyug tsam du bsam/

rlung thub tshad bzung ngo*// 'dzin pa sems kyi gnad ni/ rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis dhū ti'i nang du kha gtugs nas yod de/ sa mchu gcig gi nang du sbud mchu gnyis bcug pa lta bu'o// rtsa g.yas (222)g.yon gnyis kyi kha na hūm̐ shan ne ba gnyis gshibs nas 'dug par bsam/ steng na hūm̐ grung po gcig 'dug par bsam mo// de nas lus gnad ni mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya sgal pa la char char rgyag /ngag gnad ni 'og rlung 'then/ steng rlung drag tu mnan pas/ hūm̐ shan ne ba gnyis po des hūm̐ grung po de rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar rgyang rgyang ded nas spyi gtsug gi khruṃ la khog khog phog par bsam/ rlung ma thub tsam na sna bug na rlung phar zhad re btang la rlung lhag ma mnan/ ngal gso ba'i dus su rlung sna bug na phar la btang*/ hūm̐ lte bar lhan dbab pa'o// de'i dus su hikra ka zhes pa yid kyis bgrang*/ hikra ces hūm̐ yar la bteg /ka zhes mar la dbab ste dngos su brjod na rlung 'chor ro// de lta bu la thun bzhi la sogs par nus tshad du bsgom mo// de la rtags ni dang po spyi bo 'gul tsam 'ong*/ de nas za ba tsam 'ong*/ de nas tsha ba tsam 'ong*/ de nas tsha khol khol ba tsam 'ong*/ de tsa na rtsa mdud grol nas rlung tshangs bug tu thon te 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags yin no// de nas drag po mi dgos te/ ma yengs tsam gyis chog go /de rnams ni gong du sbyong ba'i man ngag go /de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ nam 'chi ba'i dus su cir 'dug kyang rung ste/ rtsa dbu ma dang rlung gnyis gsal gdab/ spyi bo'i bla ma mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'phags nas bzhugs par bsam zhing*/ khruṃ nag po de bsal bas tshangs bug dkar sangs kyis song bar bsam/ dbugs chad khar nang du shes pa gsal por yod pas/ yi ge hūm̐ de dhū ti'i nang na mar je mtho je mtho la tshangs bug nas bud nas zul gyis thon nas/ chos skur 'pho na hūm̐ de nam mkha' stong pa la rang yal du song bar bsam/

lus gnad srog rtsol ci yang mi dgos te/ dran pa tsam gyis chog pa yin no// de'i rgyu mtshan yang sems can yin no cog thams cad la phyi dbugs chad (223)pa'i dus su rlung sems dhū tir thim pas 'chi ba'i 'od gsal re kun la 'char ba yin te/ ngos ma zin pas 'khrul pa yin no// khyad par du mi 'di rten bzang bas/ phyi dbugs chad nas nang dbugs ma chad pa'i dus der/ shes pa 'od gsal gyi ngang la gnas pa la/ rlung sems dhū ti'i nang du gyen la 'tshangs pa yin pas las kyi stobs kyis dhū ti la tshigs pa chags pas/ rlung sems yar la ma thon pas mar log nas rlung sna bug gnyis nas 'chor zhing rig pa sgo dgu gang rung gcig na 'chor ro// de nas bar do'i 'khrul snang 'char ba yin no// 'di ru 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i gang zag de la rtsa'i tshigs pa brdol/ rtsa mdud grol bas rlung sems rtsol med du tshangs bug nas thon te gcig car mkha' spyod kyi snang ba 'char ro// gnad kyi gdams pa khyad par 'phags pa'i zhal gdams so/ ༈ /na mo gu ru/ rnal 'byor pa gang gi tshe 'pho ba'i drod tshad 'dzin pa la 'chi ltas shes dgos te/ de la phyi nang gsang ba gsum/ dang po la gnyis te/ nam phyed kyi rmi lam brtag pa dang*/ nyin par lus sems la brtag pa'o// dang po ni sngar 'gro ma myong ba'i yul phyogs gcig pur 'gro ba dang*/ gcer bur bong bu la phyi phyogs su zhon nas lho phyogs kyi lam la 'gro ba dang*/ rgya skag gi ri la me tog dmar po thu ba la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa lus sems la brtag pa'i dang po ni/ g.yu

rna ba'i 'ur sgra/ 'brug sngon mo'i 'ur sgra chad pa/ rma mig gi 'od dkar po/ bya'i mdongs nub ba/ ting nge 'dzin spyi bo'i rlangs pa/ gyi rlangs pa shor ba/ rta thig le skam pa/ mchog sngon mo'i sna chu skam pa/ glog lcam 'phar ma'i nga ro lces ro mi tshor/ ral ba/ dbus kyi ka ba sna'i ka ba nyams pa'o// la btsan gyi jag pa bkye ba'o// gnyis pa sems kyi rtags ni/ rang sdod (224)pa'i sar skyo ba dang*/ zla grogs kyis sun pa dang*/ sngar mthong ma myong ba'i yul mthong zhing yid la byed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bskyang du mi btub pa'o// nang gi 'chi ltas ni/ g.yas g.yon gyi rlung rnal mar rgyu ba chad pa ste/ spyir rnal mar rgyu ba'i rlung ni/ g.yas nas g.yon tu 'pho ba drug /g.yon nas g.yas su 'pho ba drug ste/ rlung 'pho ba bcu gnyis byed pa las/ de ltar 'pho mi btub par/ g.yas sam g.yon kho na nas rgyu na 'chi ltas so// de yang dang por ma'i dus sbyor g.yon pa'i tshe skyes pa rnams la 'chi ltas kyang g.yon nas 'byung ste/ dang por sna bug g.yon kho na nas zhag gcig rgyu na lo gsum na 'chi'o// de bzhin tu zla ba gnyis na zhag gcig rgyu na lo gnyis dang zla ba bcu na 'chi'o// yang zla ba gnyis na zhag gcig rgyu na lo gnyis dang zhag brgyad na/ de yang zla ba gcig rgyu na lo gcig dang zla ba bdun na/ de bzhin tu zla ba nyi shu rtsa dgu'i g.yon nas rgyu ba'i zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu nas zhag gsum gyi tsher 'gyur zhing*/ de nas g.yas su 'pho ste zhag gnyis g.yas kho na nas rgyu/ zhag gsum pa la g.yon tu 'phos pa nas cis kyang 'chi bar 'gyur ro// yang ma'i dus sbyor g.yas pa'i tshe skyes na 'chi ltas kyang g.yas nas 'byung ste/ dang po sna bug g.yas kho nas zhag lnga btud nas rgyu na lo gsum nas 'chi/ yang zhag lnga btud na lo gnyis na 'chi/ de lta bu gsum pas lo gcig na/ bzhi pas zla ba drug na/ lnga pas zla ba gsum na/

slar yang zhag gcig g.yas kho na nas rgyu na zla ba gnyis na/ de bzhin tu de lta bu gnyis pas zla ba gcig na/ gsum pas zla ba phyed na/ bzhi pas zhag bcu na/ lnga pas zhag lnga na/ drug pas zhag gsum na/ de nas g.yon kho na nas zhag gsum rgyu zhing*/ gsum pa la g.yas sun ma log pa'i tshe 'chi bar 'gyur ro// gsang ba'i 'chi ltas ni/ gzhan nas bshad pa lta bu'i rten 'byung ba dang*/ brten (225)pa snang ba gsum rang bzhin brgyad cu dang bcas pa'i thim lugs gsungs so// nang gi 'chi ltas de dag zhag sum cu rtsa bzhi'am rtsa drug tu 'byung ba las/ phyed tshun chad du 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs kyis bzlog cing*/ de las 'das na ni bzlog par mi 'gyur ro// 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs la yang gsum las/ phyi'i rten 'brel ni/ lam 'phrang bcos shing srog chags rnams kyi tshe skyab pa dang*/ dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul zhing skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ci nus su bsags pa'o// nang gi rten 'brel ni/ bla ma khyad par can la dbang re nod cing tshogs 'khor bya ba dang*/ gtor ma btang zhing sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ tshe gzungs 'don zhing lus ngag gi dge sbyor sngar bas lhag tu bskyed pa la sogs pa'o// gsang ba'i rten 'brel du bum pa can gyi rlung bzung ba'am/ blo rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jog pa la sogs pa'o// de ltar 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs du mas kyang bslu bar ma nus na/ 'pho ba'i dmigs pa' sbyor dgos te/ nam mkha' nas thog bab pa gang gis kyang mi bzlog pa dang 'dra bar nges par shes pa'i tshe/ rdzas dang yo byad thams cad bla ma bzhugs na bla ma la 'bul/ mched grogs la sogs pa gang zag khyad par can la yang 'bul/ dkon mchog la mchod pa bya/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur drang*/ de ltar byas la/ gnas der phyag dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ yi dam lha'i thang sku bkram/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bskang bshags bya/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba drag po gdab/ tshe 'di'i dngos po thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du bsam ste gang la yang ma chags ma zhen par byas la rtsa ba'i dge sbyor la 'bad pa 'don par bya'o// spyir 'chi ltas re re gnyis gnyis byung ba (226)la 'pho ba las sbyar du mi rung*/ mtshams med kyi las byas pa dang 'dra ste/ rgyud las/ dus la babs nas 'pho bya yi// dus min lha rnams gsod par byed// lha rnams bsad pa tsam gyis ni// nges par dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i thabs kyi sbyor ba dang mi ldan pa rnams ni 'chi ba'i tshe rlung sems sgo dgu gang rung gcig nas thon te rigs drug gi grong khyer du 'jug ste/ rgyud las/ chu las dmyal ba'i gnas su te// chu mig gis ni dud 'gror skye/ kha las yi dwags nyid du'o// sna nas gnod sbyin gnas su'o// rna ba dag nas grub pa'i lha// gal te mi gnas ye shes 'pho// mi rnams kyi ni bdag por 'gyur// ces so// de ltar ma yin par spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thon te/ bla ma yi dam lha'i thugs kar 'pho nus na de nyid gdams ngag thob ste/ rigs kyi bu/ 'khor ba ni btson dong 'dra ste/ 'dam rdzas dang 'dra/ dug gi sdong po dang 'dra gsungs nas phyag rgya chen po de nyid ngo legs par sprad de/ mngon par shes pa drug lhag ger shar nas sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// 'pho ba spyi brdol ma'i lhan thabs*/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ madh+ya ma ti ts+tshe da na u pa de sha /bod skad du/ bar do blos chod kyi man ngag /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sdom pa rgya mtsho yi// rgyud du rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// bla ma'i drin gyis bdag gis rnyed// gdams par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mtshams med gnyis dang blun po'i rigs// ba lang lta bu min la gdab// phyi dbugs chad nas ma grang bar// dbang po rab 'bring rim pas gdab// kye ma khyod ni phyi dbugs chad// nang dbugs ma chad bar de ru// 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa de// stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu ru// rjen gyis song ba nges shes bskyed// de yi ngang la ma bcos par// (227)so ma rang thad lhug par zhog

/tshe 'di'i blo 'dun blo yis thong*// rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud pa yi// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi gdams pa yod// khyod 'khor bar mi 'khyams nga rang shes// nyi zla gnyis po mtheb srin gyis// rang de re res mnan zer/ mnan la dhū tir gzhug /phyi dbugs chad nas 'phar rtsa de// 'phar 'phro bcad nas chir gyis mnan// dar cig mnan nas brjed bskul ba// da lta 'od gsal chos sku yin// ngang la lhan cig glod la zhog /mdangs gsal drod ldan spyi bo 'tshag /tsha lam pa'am rlung thol 'byung*// de ltar rtags de ma byung na// dbang po 'bring po yin par nges// g.yas g.yon rtsa ru rlung shor bas// shes pa bkra yang lam pa 'byung*// shi'am ma shi the tshom za// de yi dus su ming nas 'bod// khyod ni shi bas sngar bsgoms pa'i// bskyed rdzogs bzlas pa la sogs pa'i// 'phro de gsal gdab sgoms shig bya// de ltar brjod pas 'dzum pa'am// mig hrig pa'am mchu 'gul lam// mgo 'degs pa'am rkang lag brkyang*// drod kyang yun tu gnas pa'o// de ltar byung na thebs pa yin// dbang po shin tu dman pa la// bdun tshigs ro bsreg tsha tsha sogs// dge ba'i las la 'bad par bya// bdag nyid lha sgrub mi ldan pa'i// pha rol 'gro dgos byung ba na// tshe 'di'i 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad// g.yas pa 'og bcug mkhrig ma yis// 'phar rtsa mnan la lag pa yi// sor mo rnams kyis kha sna dgag /de yis mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro// 'di la yid gnyis mi bya'o// mai tri'i gdams pa bar do blos chod do// / bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan thugs kyi nying khu/ bar do blo chod rig pa phyi nas mthong ba'i gdams ngag go /spyir bar do la bla ma gzhan gyi gzhung gis drug dang*/ lnga dang*/ bzhi la sogs su gsungs kyang*/ 'dir bar (228)do gsum du 'dus par bzhed do// lta ba gtan la 'beb pa gzhi'i bar do// sgom pa nyams su len pa lam gyi bar do// don mngon tu gyur pa 'bras bu'i bar do'o// dang po ni/

spyir shes bya'i chos thams cad ci yang ma yin pa'i chos nyid gnyug ma khyab gdal chen por ye nas gnas pa las/ de'i don ma rtogs pa dang*/ rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis su shor/ de rtogs pa'i thabs la lta sgom spyod pa gsum du gnas so// dang po lta ba gtan la dbab pa ni/ rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems ci yang ma yin pa'i chos nyid du gnas pa de la glo bur gyi 'khrul pas bar du bcad de/ de'i thog tu bla ma dam pa'i gdams pas sbrel dgos te/ sbrel lugs kyang rten dbang po'i rim pa gang yin yang rung*/ thabs ji lta bu'i ngo sprad kyang rung ste/ lta ba rtogs tshul las mi 'da'o// de yang don spyi'i mtshan nyid du rtogs pas yid ches pa dang*/ don rang gi mtshan nyid du rtogs pas nyams su myong ba ste/ dper na sman gyi dro shes pa dang ro myong ba lta bu'o// de la spyi'i lugs kyis don spyi'i mtshan nyid du rtogs pas las 'phro 'jog pa las bar do chod mi nus par 'dod/ gdams pa 'di'i lugs kyis bsam yas lo rgyus shes pa ltar/ 'chi khar 'di ston pa'i bla ma dang 'phrad nas bar do chod par 'dod/ gal te spyi'i mtshan nyid tsam yang ma rtogs na/ bskyed rim yi dam gang yin gcig la goms 'dris bya'o// chos nyid rang gi mtshan nyid de/ skye bo gnyid sad pa ltar gnyug ma'i don rjen par mthong ba ni lta ba rtogs pa zhes bya'o// des bar do chod par 'dod de/ gnyis pa sgom pa nyams su len pa'i bar do la gnyis/ dbang po rab shes bya gcig chod du grol ba'i rigs dang*/ 'bring man chad rim gyis grol bar rigs so// rab cig car ba de ni rang ngam gzhan gyis shes bya gcig chod du rtogs nas skyes bu gnyid sad pa ltar/ (229)'khrul pa yul med du zhig pas bar do'i snang ba mi 'char bas gdams pa gdab mi dgos so// 'bring rim gyis pa la gnyis te mtshan med stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/

mtshan bcas lha bsgom pa'o// mtshan med la gnyis te/ don rang gi mtshan nyid du rtogs pa dang*/ don spyi'i mtshan nyid du go ba'o// rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs pa la gnyis te/ rang gis bar do ngos zin nas chos nyid gsal thebs pa yin no// goms 'dris chung ba la/ 'chi khar 'khrul pa'i rigs la gdams pa dgos/ yang don spyi'i mtshan nyid go la rang gi mtshan nyid ma rtogs pa la gdams pa 'di med thabs med do// yang mtshan bcas lha bsgom pa zhig la yang goms pa che ba'i rigs la mi dgos te/ bar do lha'i sku rang gis gsal thebs na 'od yang goms pa chung ba la dgos pa yin no// gsum pa mngon tu byed pa 'bras bu'i bar do la gsum te/ gang zag dngos su bzung ba dang*/ bar do gsum gyi 'char lugs dang*/ gdams ngag gdab lugs so// gdams ngag mi dgos pa'i gang zag gnyis/ gdab tu med pa'i gang zag gnyis/ gdab dgos pa bzhi ste brgyad do// gdab mi dgos pa ni/ rab shes bya gcig chod du grol ba'i rigs la mi dgos/ 'bring goms pa shin tu che ba la mi dgos so// gdab tu med pa'i gang zag gnyis ni/ sdig po che mtshams med lnga byas pa'i gang zag la bar do'i snang ba mi 'char te/ dbugs song ba ni btso sreg gi snang ba 'char ro// lam gang la yang goms 'dris med pas chos sgor zhugs tsam gyi gang zag de la yang gdab tu med do// 'di'i rigs la yang 'chi khar bla ma sleb na phan thogs nges gsungs/ gdab dgos pa'i gang zag la bzhi ste/ lta ba spyi'i mtshan nyid du go yang ngo ma sprad pa la dgos te/ dper na bsam yas kyi lo rgyus shes kyang mthong ma myong ba zhig la/ lam der zhugs pa'i tshe na bsam yas rgyus can gcig gis (230)'di/ yin no byas pa tsam gyis sngar gyi lo rgyus dang mthun nas lam gyis ngo shes nas lta ba ltar/ lta ba'i go yul yod pa gcig la bla ma gcig gis khyod la bar do dang po'i 'od gsal bya ba de phyi dbugs chad pa dang chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar stong rjen gyis 'char ba yin gyi/

de ngo shes par gyis la de'i ngang la zhog cig /de'i dus la ngas kyang ngo sprad kyi byas pas/ bar do dang po ngos zin te the tshom med do// yang gnyis pa ngo sprad kyang goms 'dris chung ba rnams kyis bar do rang gis gsal thebs mi nus pas de la yang bla mas bskul dgos so// gsum pa sngar goms 'dris yod kyang 'chi kha drag por 'khrul nas dran pas ye ma zin pa'i rigs la gdams pa 'di dgos so// yang bzhi pa sngar goms 'dris yod kyang sdom pa shor ba'am/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams nas ngan song du 'gro ba'i rigs de la shin tu dgos te/ bar do dang por them na rab/ de la ma thebs na bar do gnyis par btab pas rig pa sad nas grol ba yin/ de la yang bar do gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus bya ba shi'am ma shi ngo mi shes pa'i shes pa gsal lam pa cig yod/ dus der gdams pa thebs na chos nyid ma bu 'phrad nas las kyis kha bsgyur du med do// dper na nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa bcom pa bzhin tu lam gyis las kyi nus pa bcom nas grol ba yin no// gnyis pa bar do gsum gyi 'char lugs bstan pa ni/ bar do dang po chos nyid 'od gsal zhes bya ba chos kyi sku'i dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa zhig 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud la 'char ste/ de la phyi dbugs chad/ nang dbugs ma chad pa'i rlung dhū tir thim pa'i bar yin no// de la phal pa rnams shes pa brgyal zer/ yun ni nges pa med/ rten bzang ngan dang rtsa rlung gi rim pa yin no// de nas rtsa g.yas g.yon gyi rlung shor ba dang bar do gnyis pa yid kyi lus su lam gyis 'char ba (231)yin no// de yang las ngan gyis rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis gang rung du 'gro/ de'i dus su shi'am ma shi ngo mi shes/ ngu rgod byas pa thos/ shes nas sngar bzhin byas pas tho yul du 'khor ro// de'i dus su bar do'i gdams ngag thob na don 'grub ste/ da rung las kyi 'khrul snang ma shar bas gang du yang bsgyur du btub bo// de nas bar do gsum pa las kyi 'khrul snang bya ba 'char te/

nye dus ngu rgod byas/ zas skal bcad/ gos bshus/ mal sa phyags/ rang gis khong mthong yang*/ khong gis rang mi mthong*/ khong gis bos pa rang gis thos kyang*/ rang gis bos pa khong gis ma thos pas snying mi dga' phyad kyis 'gro'o// de'i tshe rigs drug gi gnas mthong*/ yul la chags thogs med/ las 'khrul snang ci yang 'char/ gshin rje'i pho nyas 'tshe/ rang gar skye'i 'gro ba rnams mthong*/ de la chags sdang skyes na skye ba'i sgo bzhi gang rung zhig la 'jug go /de'i dus su gdams ngag theb pa dka' ste/ shes pa 'phyo/ las kyi 'khrul pas bdas nas tho yul du res 'ga' las mi 'khor ro// de'i tshe shul na yod pa rnams kyis lan mo byed pas/ de dus kyi dge ba stobs chen gnas ngan pa las ldog nus so// gsum pa gdams ngag gdab lugs ni/ bar do gsum la/ blos chod kyi gdams ngag gdab ste/ dpe chu'i 'ol kha bsgyur ba dang 'dra/ de yang bar do dang po 'od gsal blos chod/ bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus blos chod/ bar do gsum pa 'khrul snang blos chod do// bar do dang po 'od gsal blos chod la yang gsum/ nam gdab pa'i dus dang*/ ji ltar gdab pa'i thabs/ thebs ma thebs kyi rtags so// nam gdab pa'i dus ni/ phyi dbugs chad ma khad gdab ste/ tshe 'di'i snang ba nub/ bar do'i 'khrul snang ma shar ba rlung a ba dhū tir thim nas/ shes pa (232)'od gsal gyi ngang la gnas pa dar cig 'ong bas de'i dus su gdab bo// ji ltar gdab pa'i thabs ni/ bla ma mched grogs kyis sngar nas khyod la dbugs chad nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der 'od gsal chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu stong rjen pa zhig 'char bas de ngo shes par gyis la de'i ngang du shes pa lhod kyis glod la zhog cig ces bslab bo// de nas dbugs 'gro khar rtsa g.yas g.yon gnyis la mthe bong reg tsam byas la bsdad/ dbugs nar song ba dang rtsa 'phar 'phro chad pa dang rtsa chir gyis mnan no// yun ni zan gcig za ring tsam mo// de'i dus su brjed bskul ba ni/

'o de ni bar do 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin pas/ de'i ngang la shes pa lhan gyis glod la zhog cig bya'o// thebs ma thebs kyi rtags ni/ thebs na bzhin mdangs gsal/ drod yun tu gnas/ spyi bor 'tshag pa'am tsha lam pa'am rlangs thol ba 'byung ba yin no// ma thebs na rtags de rnams mi 'ong bas bar do gnyis pa la bzung dgos so// bar do gnyis pa sgyu lus blos chod la gsum ste/ nam gdab pa'i dus/ ji ltar gdab pa'i thabs/ thebs ma thebs kyi rtags so// nam gdab pa'i dus ni/ bar do'i 'od gsal ma zin na dhū ti'i nang nas rlung log ste/ rtsa g.yas g.yon tu rlung shor bas shes pa bkra lam ba 'ong*/ de nas nga shi ba yin nam ma shi ba yin snyam mo// de nas ro bsdus/ mal phyags/ ngu rgod byas/ zas skam skal pa bcad pa dang*/ da nga shi ba 'dug snyam/ snying mi dga' shad 'gro bas de dus gdab bo// ji ltar gdab pa'i tshul ni gnyis te/ gang zag de chos nyid stong pa bsgom pa dang*/ mtshan bcas lha bsgom pa gang yin ngo shes par byas la/ gnyis ka la thun mong gi bya btang lnga ldan/ khyad par gyi bya btang re res gdams ngag gdab bo// thun mong gi bya btang lnga pa ni/ ming nas 'bod pa dang*/ khyod ni shi ba yin no// de ni bar do yin no// bla ma dran (233)par gyis shig /gdams ngag dran par gyis shig /ces gsal gdab bo// khyad par gyi bya btang re re ni/ stong nyid sgom pa yin na de gsal gdab/ bskyed rim sgom na de gsal gdab/ gdab pa bla ma'i zhal las shes so// thebs pa'i rtags ni 'dzum pa'am/ mig hrig pa'am/ mchu 'gul ba'am/ mgo 'degs pa'am/ rkang pa shad pa'am/ bzhin gyi mdongs mi 'chor/ drod yun tu gnas so// de tsho gang byung yang chog go /de ltar byung na bar do zin pa yin pas/ shul du dge ba'i las ci yang mi dgos so// de la ma zin na bar do gsum pa 'khrul snang blos chod bya ba yin/ 'khrul snang zings kyis langs nas gdams ngag mi thebs pas shul du dge ba'i las la 'bad do// khos kyang de'i lan mo byed pas phan no// bsngo ba byas pas kyang phan no// spyir goms pa che chung gang la yang 'chi kar bag re 'khrul pa mang ngo*// goms pa che ba rnams la bem rig bral nas chos nyid du lam gyis 'ong*/

chung ba la dka' bas gdams pa 'di med thabs med do// goms pa che chung dang*/ ngo 'phrod ma 'phrod 'chi khar 'khrul ma 'khrul med par/ rig pa phyi thas mthong ba yin no// bar do rang stobs kyis ma zin yang*/ gzhan rkyen la brten nas zin nges pas/ lam blos chod du 'gro nges pa yin no// bar do blos chod kyi zhal gdams so// brgyud pa gsang*/ gdams pa gang*/ yid la spong*/ the tshom shig /bka' rgyas sdoms/ bka' ma'am/ gter ma'am/ lung bstan pa snyam du yid la mi bya bar nyams su blang ngo*/// /(234)
